caption: The drawing features a cylindrical box with a lid, decorated with elaborate patterns. The surface of the box is covered with intricate gold scrollwork and floral motifs in shades of pink, red, green, and blue on a light background. The top edge of the box lid is encircled by a red and black floral border, with a striped pattern right below it. Pink and blue flowers with green leaves appear at intervals among the gold decorative elements, and there are also patches of light blue lattice-like designs. The composition is centered on the paper, and the box's decoration is detailed and evenly distributed across the visible surfaces. The background of the image is left plain and uncolored.
title: Bandbox
